methodology.statistic: median of timed runs (raw samples retained)
methodology.rustWasm: wasm-bindgen --target nodejs, wasm32-unknown-unknown +simd128, slices copied into linear memory per call
methodology.refactor: factorize() of the refactor matrix (last OP Newton matrix, or a perturbed first matrix for linear decks) on the same pattern; refactorReusedPivots tells whether pivot reuse succeeded or the kernel fell back to a full factorization
methodology.refactorPerturbed: factorize() of the first matrix with a deterministic +-3e-6 relative perturbation right after factoring the first matrix: isolates the pivot-reuse kernel
methodology.ngspice: ngspice -b on the OP deck, option klu|sparse via .spiceinit, Total analysis time and matrix phases from .options acct
